name: comby-js
description: JavaScript build of Comby's core structural match and rewrite engine.

scripts.build: opam exec -- dune build bin/comby_js.bundle.js && mkdir -p dist && (chmod u+w dist/comby.js 2>/dev/null || true) && cp _build/default/bin/comby_js.bundle.js dist/comby.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/smoke.js && node test/regex-suite.js && node test/cli-smoke.js
